name: support-v1
goal: Each story clearly shows or clearly lacks each simple building block
problem: Support atoms that rebuild weak atoms (consumer prices, energy prices, supply cuts, wrongdoing) by rule
note: Building blocks, each one observable on its own. Written before any answers were seen.

probes.a: Does {file} mention a price, cost, fee, bill, fare, rent or tariff?
probes.b: Does {file} talk about how much something costs?
probes.reversed: Does {file} say nothing about what anything costs?

probes.a: Does {file} say that a price, cost, rate or amount has changed?
probes.b: Does {file} describe an amount going up or down?
probes.reversed: Does {file} say that an amount stayed the same?

probes.a: Does {file} say that something increased, rose or went up?
probes.b: Does {file} describe a number or amount getting higher?
probes.reversed: Does {file} say that something decreased, fell or went down?

probes.a: Does {file} mention households, shoppers, customers, tenants, passengers or patients?
probes.b: Does {file} talk about ordinary people as buyers or users of something?
probes.reversed: Does {file} talk only about companies, governments or markets, not ordinary people?

probes.a: Does {file} mention food, fuel, electricity, gas, rent, transport, phone bills or other everyday purchases?
probes.b: Does {file} talk about things people buy or pay for every week?
probes.reversed: Does {file} talk only about luxury, rare or business-only goods?

probes.a: Does {file} mention oil, gas, petrol, electricity, power plants or fuel?
probes.b: Does {file} talk about energy supplies or energy use?

probes.a: Does {file} report a shortage, outage, blockade, strike or shutdown stopping supplies?
probes.b: Does {file} describe goods, fuel or power not reaching people?
probes.reversed: Does {file} report supplies flowing normally or being restored?

probes.a: Does {file} mention a government, ministry, official, court, police force or public body?
probes.b: Does {file} talk about a public institution or someone working for one?
probes.reversed: Does {file} involve only private people or companies, with no public body?

probes.a: Does {file} report someone accused of, charged with or investigated for wrongdoing?
probes.b: Does {file} describe an allegation, inquiry, lawsuit or scandal?
probes.reversed: Does {file} report someone being cleared or found innocent?

decisions: Where does the story in {file} mainly take place or matter?
How much does the story in {file} change ordinary people's lives?
Can this be answered from the story text shown?
